title: Cute but flawed.
text: Cute but flawed.. Although this guy is cute he needs some tweaking. The hand does not stay up on one side of the advent rendering it useless. My husband is going to work on fixing it. But, it should come working properly. This is a pretty cheapy item but is still cute and my daughter thinks it will be so fun to hang up over Christmas and count down....that is if we can fix it.
